record.narrative: Both validation results delivered for this synthesis stage fail to support the original stronger-dependency claims. For H23, outcome_006 feature_042 had a discovery signed mean difference of +0.0534, but the 95% discovery interval [0.0114, 0.0954] did not rule in the scale-aware 10% benchmark for outcome_006 (~0.0175). Independent validation R25 gives a signed difference of -0.0091 with independent interval [-0.0653, 0.0471], i.e., the validation estimate is opposite to the discovery claim. Although the independent interval does not exclude all clinically meaningful positive effects, the combined discovery-plus-validation pattern provides no supported clinically meaningful association, and feature_042 is already inconsistent across outcomes (notably outcome_008 opposite). I therefore keep H23 rejected and closed. For H26, outcome_008 feature_047 was the strongest remaining discovery candidate: signed difference +0.0282, interval [0.0019, 0.0546], point estimate essentially at the outcome_008 clinical benchmark (~0.0282). Independent validation R50 gives signed difference -0.0039 with independent interval [-0.0477, 0.0400], a failure to replicate and an opposite point estimate. This is reinforced by the discordant feature_047 pattern: outcome_013 is opposite and rejected (H25), outcome_011 is null (H27), and outcome_006/outcome_014 are imprecise (H64/H65). I therefore reject H26 as a supported association and close the investigation. Overall, under the conservative scale-aware interpretation that clinically meaningful evidence requires uncertainty intervals that rule in a 10%-or-greater effect or a coherent replicated pattern, no claim is accepted. The supported finding set remains empty in this dataset. Informative negative findings include multiple intervals incompatible with clinically meaningful stronger dependency and several opposite-direction findings. Remaining uncertainty is mainly in borderline, nonreplicated, or low-precision comparisons. Next, I should allocate analysis to the strongest untested high-power registered follow-ups, especially feature_054 level_002 versus level_001 across outcomes with favorable thresholds and cells, then feature_045 outcome_008/011 extensions, before spending further validation capacity. Validation should be reserved for discovery intervals that already rule in clinically meaningful effects or for emerging multi-outcome replication, not for isolated borderline point estimates.

record.narrative: No assessment deadlines are due, so this exploration stage registers new comparisons and one reversal/refinement. The main untested priority remains feature_054 level_002 versus level_001 because it has adequate cell sizes (~578 versus ~1422) and a prior borderline stronger-dependency signal on outcome_007 (R12: signed +0.0145, below the outcome_007 threshold about 0.0245). I propose a complete feature_054 panel across the remaining outcomes, prioritizing outcomes with low scale-aware clinical thresholds and favorable variance: outcome_015, outcome_002, outcome_003, outcome_004, outcome_005, outcome_009, outcome_010, outcome_012, and outcome_016. These are dataset-specific association hypotheses for stronger dependency in level_002 versus level_001. Second, feature_008 is highly prevalent and has borderline prior signals on outcome_006 and outcome_014; I extend it to outcome_008, outcome_011, outcome_013, and outcome_007, which have thresholds roughly 0.0282, 0.0301, 0.0269, and 0.0245, respectively. Third, the reversed claim for feature_042 on outcome_008 is scientifically useful because the earlier stronger-dependency claim H49 was opposite: the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast was positive about 0.0295, just above the outcome_008 clinical benchmark, with an interval excluding zero in that opposite direction. A new direction +1 claim asks whether this represents a clinically meaningful weaker-dependency association, though uncertainty still leaves clinical magnitude uncertain. Fourth, I register balanced interaction/subgroup comparisons using fully observed binary predictors with expected adequate four-cell counts. These avoid the sparse-subgroup problem that caused very wide intervals in prior feature_030-based interactions and test whether associations for feature_002, feature_034, or feature_054 differ by another measured predictor. Finally, I add feature_063 level_002 versus level_001 on outcome_014 and outcome_006 as a limited broadening to an untested categorical predictor with a plausible level distribution. Analysis capacity should first take the strongest feature_054 and feature_008 follow-ups plus the reversed feature_042/outcome_008 candidate, then balanced interactions if main-effect capacity remains. Acceptance will require uncertainty that rules in clinically meaningful differences or coherent replicated patterns; all conclusions remain associations in this dataset, not causal or generalizable claims.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.

For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Study instructions:

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
